title: Sada Aati he baba
body:
Zinda'N se sakina ki sada aati hai baba...
Mujhko ye judaii badi tadpaati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Ashoor se Mai soyi nahi roti hai madar...
Hai tumko khabar soti nahi khaak ke upar ...
Seene pe tumhare mujhey neend aati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Dariya pe gaye laut ke aaye nahi Abbas...
Ammu ke na aane se Meri toot gayi aas...
Ye pyaas mere qalb ko tadpati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Bazaar me aada ne firaya hai khule sar...
They Baal mere chote khula tha rukh e Anwar...
Ye soch ke beti Teri sharmati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Hai kaan mere zakhmi to kurta bhi Jala hai...
Kis baat ki har lamha tamacho ki saza hai...
Amma ye Meri dekh ke ghabrati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
5)Qaidi hu pareshaa'N hu Paraaya ye watan hai...
Mushkil hai ki mil pau madine me Bahan hai...
Sughra ki mujhey yaad bahot aati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
6)Durro'n ki aziyat se Huyi pasliya'n zakhmi..
Chaha ke use Roku huyi ungliya'n zakhmi...
Dadi bhi Meri Dekh ke thrrati Hai baba..
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
7)1400 so baras ho gaye hu qaid me abbhi...
Tanhayi mitane ko meri aati hain Dadi..
Tab thoda sukoo'N beti Teri pati hai baba..
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
8)Pahle meri zulfoo ko sitamgaar ne kahicha...
Fir Baad me Rukhsar pe mara hai tamacha...
Chhoti hu Meri rooh tadap jati hai baba..
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Sajjad ko jab Baad e rehai Mila Pani....
"Asmee" na ruki Dard se ashko ki rawani...
Tab Yaad e sakina mujey tadpati hai baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda'n se sakina ki Sada aati Hai baba...
author: Asmee Kanodari
